question: How can initiation that cuts away impurities be possible in the dualist view?
premises: Initiation is defined as that which cuts away impurities.
The dualists hold a view of real difference.
The possibility of such cutting must be explained within that view.
inference: Initiation as removal of impurities is difficult to justify on the dualist position.
plain_english: For example, initiation is that which cuts away impurities; but how can this possibly be explained in the view of those who assert difference?
